{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders, excluding any NaN values
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue_completed"}
